fun_facts: In Kansas’s 2026 season opener, Isaiah Marshall threw for 246 yards and two touchdowns.
Against West Virginia, Isaiah Marshall rushed for a career-high 164 yards and a touchdown.
In Kansas’s three-overtime game against BYU, Isaiah Marshall passed for 186 yards and two touchdowns, then added 90 rushing yards and another score.
By Nov. 24, Isaiah Marshall led Kansas in both passing and rushing: 1,868 passing yards and 692 rushing yards, with 11 passing touchdowns and five rushing touchdowns.
